pages.title: A Quiet Delivery
pages.text: Hit a hostile creature with a real poison-tipped dart from a Bamboo Blowgun.

pages.title: A Quiet Delivery
pages.text: Ordinary darts supply future ammunition preparation and cooked fish provisions another hunting trip.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the native blowgun and dart recipes, choose poison ammunition and shoot a hostile creature. Player targets and command projectiles do not count.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Follow the native Bamboo Blowgun and tipped dart recipes. The ranged tool supports poison-delivering tipped ammunition.
